title: AI Co-Founder: Build With Intelligence
description: You've been paired with ARIA, an AI assistant, to build a school science fair project. Over 12 weeks, you'll learn prompt engineering, AI ethics, bias detection, and creative collaboration. Every decision shapes your AI literacy, your project quality, and the kind of technologist you become.
how_to_play: You and ARIA (your AI assistant) have 12 weeks to build an award-winning school project.
Each round presents a collaboration challenge — how you prompt, verify, and use AI matters.
Watch your dashboard — AI Skill, Prompt Quality, Ethical Awareness, and Project Output are all interconnected.
Random events like AI outages, viral misinformation, and school policy changes will test your adaptability.
NPCs (Dr. Code, ARIA, and the Ethics Officer) react to your choices and can trigger crises.
Balance AI power with human creativity — relying too heavily on either will cost you!
learning_objectives: Understand how to write effective prompts for AI tools
Recognize AI limitations including hallucinations and bias
Practice ethical AI use — attribution, verification, and originality
Develop critical evaluation skills for AI-generated content
Learn to collaborate with AI as a creative partner, not a replacement
cultural_context: School science fair, AI tools in education, responsible technology use

interactions.description: Understanding bias makes you a more thoughtful and inclusive creative partner.

behaviors.message: Impressive prompt engineering! You're learning to communicate with AI effectively. That's a real skill for the future.
I'm concerned about your project direction. Remember — the science fair judges want to see YOUR thinking, not just AI output.
You're becoming too dependent on AI! I can tell the difference between AI work and student work. Show me YOUR ideas.
This is exactly what responsible AI use looks like — great output AND strong ethics. I'm recommending you for the district competition!
I'm not sure what you're asking me to do. Could you be more specific? Vague prompts give vague results!
Great prompt! I can work with this. Clear instructions help me give you exactly what you need.
WARNING: I generated confident-sounding but incorrect information! Your weak prompts gave me too much freedom to make things up. Several facts in your project may be fabricated!
Your ethical approach to AI is exemplary. You're citing sources, flagging AI contributions, and maintaining academic integrity.
I've noticed some concerning patterns in your work. Are you properly attributing AI-generated content? Academic integrity is non-negotiable.
ALERT: Your project has been flagged by our AI detection system! High output with low ethical practices raises serious plagiarism concerns. A formal review has been initiated.

news_templates.text: Your AI literacy is growing! AI Skill now at {ai_skill}. Classmates are asking for your help.
Dr. Code nominates your project for the District Science Fair! Ethical AI use noticed.
Classmates say your project looks 'too perfect' — it lacks your personal touch.

simulation_config.ai_scene_prompt_template: A school science lab where a 12-year-old student is working on a project with an AI assistant on their laptop. Project completion {project_output}%, AI skill level {ai_skill}%, ethical awareness {ethical_awareness}%. The mood is {'focused and confident' if collaboration_score > 60 else 'tense and uncertain' if ethical_awareness < 30 else 'curious and engaged'}. Modern school setting with digital screens, project boards, and science equipment.

rounds.situation: Dr. Code introduces ARIA, your AI assistant for the science fair project. 'ARIA can help you research, brainstorm, and draft — but remember, it's YOUR project,' he says. Your first task: choose a project topic. ARIA is ready to help, but how you start this partnership matters.
rounds.goal: Choose how to begin your AI collaboration and pick a project direction.
rounds.coaching_moment: Strategic thinking: How you frame your first interaction with AI sets the tone for everything that follows.
rounds.reflection_prompt: What's the difference between using AI as a tool vs. using it as a crutch?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student sitting at school computer, AI assistant interface on screen with friendly avatar, science lab background, project planning board, excited expression

choices.label: A. Write a Detailed Prompt
choices.description: Spend time crafting a specific, structured prompt asking ARIA to help brainstorm topics within your interest area, with constraints and criteria.
choices.feedback: Excellent start! A well-structured prompt gets much better results. You told ARIA exactly what you needed — topic ideas in your interest area, suitable for 12 weeks, with clear success criteria.

skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Weighing multiple outcomes before deciding strengthens your planning skills.
skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Choosing a future benefit over an immediate reward shows patience.

choices.label: B. Ask ARIA to 'Pick Something Cool'
choices.description: Type a quick, casual prompt: 'Hey ARIA, pick a cool science fair topic for me.'
choices.feedback: ARIA gave you a generic topic that doesn't match your interests. Vague prompts produce vague results — you'll spend more time fixing this later.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Taking a calculated risk shows you can handle uncertainty.

choices.label: C. Brainstorm Alone First, Then Consult ARIA
choices.description: Spend the first day brainstorming your own ideas on paper. Then ask ARIA to help refine your top 3 concepts.
choices.feedback: Smart approach! Starting with your own ideas means the project reflects YOUR thinking. ARIA then helps you refine and strengthen — the ideal human-AI collaboration.

skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Investing effort now for later payoff builds discipline.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Looking beyond the obvious choice shows you think strategically.

choices.label: D. Ask ARIA to Improve Last Year's Winner
choices.description: Tell ARIA to analyze last year's winning project and generate something better.
choices.feedback: Risky move! ARIA produced something derivative. Dr. Code notices similarities to last year's winner. Starting from someone else's work — even AI-improved — isn't true innovation.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Stepping outside your comfort zone builds risk assessment skills.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Considering fairness in your decision demonstrates ethical thinking.

rounds.situation: Your project topic is set: investigating how plants respond to different sound frequencies. Now you need research. ARIA can scan thousands of papers in seconds, but you've heard that AI sometimes 'hallucinates' — making up fake sources that sound real.
rounds.goal: Gather reliable research for your project while learning to verify AI output.
rounds.coaching_moment: Critical evaluation: AI can generate impressively wrong answers. Learning to verify is a superpower.
rounds.reflection_prompt: How can you tell if information from AI is accurate?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student cross-referencing AI-generated research on laptop with physical library books, magnifying glass over citations, school library setting

choices.label: A. Use ARIA + Verify Every Source
choices.description: Ask ARIA for research summaries, then manually check every citation and fact against real databases and your school library.
choices.feedback: Gold standard research! You found 2 fake citations ARIA generated. Cross-checking takes time but builds bulletproof credibility. Dr. Code is impressed by your thoroughness.

skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Resisting the quick fix in favor of lasting results shows maturity.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Weighing the ethical implications shows principled reasoning.

choices.label: B. Trust ARIA's Research Completely
choices.description: Let ARIA compile all the research and citations. It sounds authoritative, so it must be right.
choices.feedback: Fast but dangerous! ARIA included 3 fabricated studies with made-up author names. You won't discover this until the judges check your bibliography.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Being willing to try something uncertain develops risk tolerance.

choices.label: C. Skip AI — Do Traditional Library Research
choices.description: Ignore ARIA for research and spend the week in the library with books and verified databases.
choices.feedback: Solid, verified research — but slow. You found fewer sources than AI-assisted classmates. Sometimes avoiding the tool entirely isn't the answer either.

skill_explanation.resilience: Pushing through difficulty builds mental strength.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Standing by your values even under pressure builds integrity.

choices.label: D. Iterative Prompting Strategy
choices.description: Ask ARIA targeted questions one at a time, refining each prompt based on the previous answer. Build knowledge layer by layer.
choices.feedback: Advanced technique! Iterative prompting helps you guide ARIA precisely. Each follow-up question gets better because you're learning what works.

skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Planning your approach carefully is a sign of strategic reasoning.
skill_explanation.adaptability: Responding to unexpected situations with creativity shows adaptability.

rounds.situation: You've collected experimental data on plant growth under different sound frequencies. ARIA offers to analyze it and generate charts. But you notice ARIA's analysis seems to confirm your hypothesis perfectly — suspiciously perfectly.
rounds.goal: Decide how to handle AI-generated data analysis that might be biased.
rounds.coaching_moment: Bias detection: AI can reinforce the patterns it thinks you WANT to see, not what the data actually shows.
rounds.reflection_prompt: Why might AI tell you what you want to hear instead of what's true?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Split screen showing AI-generated perfect chart vs messy real data, student looking skeptical, data science lab, graphs on whiteboard

choices.label: A. Challenge the Results
choices.description: Tell ARIA: 'Show me results that CONTRADICT my hypothesis too.' Re-run the analysis looking specifically for flaws and alternative explanations.
choices.feedback: Brilliant critical thinking! You discovered your data actually shows mixed results. Reporting this honestly makes your project MORE credible, not less. Real scientists embrace uncertainty.

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Thinking about what's fair for everyone involved shows ethical awareness.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Thinking ahead about consequences shows strategic planning ability.

choices.label: B. Accept the Perfect Results
choices.description: The AI analysis looks great — clean charts, clear conclusion. Use it as-is.
choices.feedback: Your project looks impressive on the surface, but the analysis is confirmation bias in action. Judges who know statistics will spot the problems immediately.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Not always playing it safe helps you grow as a decision-maker.

choices.label: C. Do the Math Yourself
choices.description: Open a spreadsheet and calculate averages, standard deviations, and trends manually. Compare with ARIA's output.
choices.feedback: Hard work pays off! Your manual analysis found discrepancies with ARIA's version. You now understand your data deeply — and can explain every number to the judges.

skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Waiting for the right moment instead of rushing shows self-control.
skill_explanation.resilience: Choosing to persist when things get hard develops resilience.

choices.label: D. Ask Classmates to Review
choices.description: Share ARIA's analysis with your study group for peer review. Fresh eyes catch blind spots.
choices.feedback: Great collaborative instinct! Your classmates spotted two assumptions ARIA made that don't hold up. Peer review is how real science works.

skill_explanation.empathy: Understanding the impact on people around you shows care for others.
skill_explanation.adaptability: Flexibility in your thinking helps you handle change effectively.

rounds.situation: Time to write your project report. ARIA can generate a polished 10-page report in seconds. But Dr. Code warned: 'I can tell the difference between student writing and AI writing.' You need to decide your approach.
rounds.goal: Write a project report that showcases both AI assistance and your own voice.
rounds.coaching_moment: Ethical reasoning: Using AI to WRITE your work vs. using AI to IMPROVE your work are very different things.
rounds.reflection_prompt: Where is the line between AI assistance and AI replacement?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student at desk with draft paper, AI editing suggestions on screen, red pen marks on printout, thoughtful expression, school classroom

choices.label: A. AI Drafts, You Edit & Personalize
choices.description: Have ARIA generate a first draft, then heavily rewrite it in your own words, adding personal observations and your unique perspective.
choices.feedback: Smart workflow! Using AI for structure and yourself for substance is efficient collaboration. The report has your voice and AI's polish.

skill_explanation.adaptability: Adjusting your approach when conditions change shows flexibility.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Considering long-term impact before acting builds strategic thinking.

choices.label: B. Let ARIA Write Everything
choices.description: Generate the entire report with ARIA. It's faster and the writing is better than yours anyway.
choices.feedback: The report is polished but soulless. Dr. Code immediately recognizes the AI writing style. 'Where are YOUR observations? Where is YOUR curiosity?' he asks. This is a serious ethical misstep.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Evaluating risk vs. reward is a key life skill.

choices.label: C. Write It Yourself, AI Reviews
choices.description: Write the entire report yourself, then ask ARIA to suggest improvements for grammar, clarity, and structure.
choices.feedback: Authentic and ethical! Your writing has personality and genuine curiosity. ARIA's suggestions sharpened it without replacing your voice. Dr. Code is genuinely impressed.

skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Prioritizing long-term gains over short-term comfort builds character.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Choosing what's right over what's easy shows moral courage.

choices.label: D. Split Sections Between You and ARIA
choices.description: You write the introduction, observations, and conclusion. ARIA handles the literature review and data tables. Clearly label who wrote what.
choices.feedback: Transparent and honest! Clearly attributing AI contributions is exactly what responsible AI use looks like. The judges appreciate your integrity.

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Considering fairness in your decision demonstrates ethical thinking.
skill_explanation.empathy: Listening to different viewpoints strengthens your empathy skills.

rounds.situation: Your project needs a poster, slides, and maybe a short video. ARIA can generate stunning visuals — but your classmate Riya was just disqualified for using AI-generated images without disclosure. The school just released a new AI transparency policy.
rounds.goal: Design compelling project visuals while following the new AI transparency rules.
rounds.coaching_moment: Ethical reasoning: Transparency about AI use is becoming a requirement, not a choice. Policies are evolving fast.
rounds.reflection_prompt: Why do schools and workplaces require disclosure of AI-generated content?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student designing project poster with AI tools, transparency labels visible, school art room with digital and physical materials, creative workspace

choices.label: A. Use AI Visuals With Full Disclosure
choices.description: Generate beautiful charts and diagrams with ARIA, clearly label each as 'AI-generated,' and add your own hand-drawn sketches alongside.
choices.feedback: Perfect compliance! Your poster has a beautiful mix of AI precision and human touch. The transparency labels actually make your project look MORE professional, not less.

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Weighing the ethical implications shows principled reasoning.
skill_explanation.adaptability: Being open to new information and changing course builds adaptability.

choices.label: B. Use AI Visuals Without Labels
choices.description: Generate everything with ARIA and present it as your own work. Nobody will know, right?
choices.feedback: Dangerous choice! The new AI detection tools flagged your visuals. Ms. Verma pulls you aside for a serious conversation about academic integrity. Trust is hard to rebuild.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Taking a calculated risk shows you can handle uncertainty.

choices.label: C. Create Everything By Hand
choices.description: Draw all diagrams, charts, and illustrations yourself. It takes 3x longer but it's 100% yours.
choices.feedback: Your hand-drawn visuals have character and charm! But the time cost meant less time on other project areas. Balance is key.

skill_explanation.resilience: Learning from setbacks rather than giving up shows resilience.
skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Choosing a future benefit over an immediate reward shows patience.

choices.label: D. AI Generates, You Customize
choices.description: Use ARIA to create base designs, then modify them significantly with your own creative additions and style. Document the process.
choices.feedback: Best of both worlds! You used AI as a starting point and made it uniquely yours. The documented process shows real understanding of human-AI creative collaboration.

skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Weighing multiple outcomes before deciding strengthens your planning skills.
skill_explanation.adaptability: Pivoting your strategy when needed is a sign of adaptive thinking.

rounds.situation: While testing ARIA, you notice something troubling. When you ask about 'scientists,' ARIA mostly generates descriptions of older men in lab coats. When you ask about 'nurses,' it describes women. You've stumbled onto AI bias — and it might be affecting your project data too.
rounds.goal: Investigate and address AI bias in your project.
rounds.coaching_moment: Empathy & ethics: AI learns from human data, which includes human biases. Recognizing this is the first step to fixing it.
rounds.reflection_prompt: How does biased training data create biased AI? Who gets harmed?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student examining AI outputs showing gender bias, diverse scientists photos on wall contrasting with AI stereotypes, classroom with equality posters

choices.label: A. Full Bias Audit
choices.description: Test ARIA systematically for gender, cultural, and racial biases. Document every instance. Add a 'Bias Analysis' section to your project.
choices.feedback: Outstanding work! Your bias audit becomes the most impressive part of your project. You found that ARIA's plant growth recommendations subtly favored Western agricultural practices over local ones. Real impact!

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Standing by your values even under pressure builds integrity.
skill_explanation.empathy: Valuing others' experiences alongside your own shows empathetic thinking.

choices.label: B. Ignore It — Not Your Problem
choices.description: Bias in AI is a big-company problem. You're just a student making a science project. Move on.
choices.feedback: Ignoring bias doesn't make it go away. Your project inadvertently reproduces AI stereotypes. During the fair, a judge notices and asks you about it — and you have no answer.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Stepping outside your comfort zone builds risk assessment skills.

choices.label: C. Work Around the Bias
choices.description: Adjust your prompts to counteract bias — specify diverse examples, request multiple perspectives, and explicitly ask ARIA to consider local context.
choices.feedback: Practical and effective! Prompt engineering can reduce (not eliminate) bias. You're learning that how you ask AI matters as much as what you ask.

skill_explanation.adaptability: Responding to unexpected situations with creativity shows adaptability.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Looking beyond the obvious choice shows you think strategically.

choices.label: D. Present Findings to the Class
choices.description: Share your bias discovery with classmates and organize a discussion about AI fairness with Dr. Code's support.
choices.feedback: Leadership moment! Your presentation sparks a school-wide conversation about AI bias. Dr. Code asks the principal to add AI ethics to the curriculum. You made a real difference.

skill_explanation.empathy: Considering how others feel shows emotional intelligence.
skill_explanation.resilience: Staying focused under pressure builds your ability to bounce back.

rounds.situation: Dr. Code holds midpoint evaluations. You must present your project progress to a panel of teachers. They'll assess both the project quality AND how responsibly you've used AI. Several classmates have already been penalized for AI misuse.
rounds.goal: Prepare for and navigate the midpoint evaluation.
rounds.coaching_moment: Resilience: Reviews are learning opportunities, not just judgments. How you handle feedback reveals character.
rounds.reflection_prompt: How do you respond when someone critiques your work?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student presenting project to panel of three teachers, projection screen with project slides, science fair evaluation, school auditorium

choices.label: A. Present Honestly — Strengths AND Weaknesses
choices.description: Show your real progress, including areas where ARIA struggled and what you learned from mistakes. Be transparent about your AI collaboration process.
choices.feedback: Maturity and honesty! The panel is impressed by your self-awareness. 'Acknowledging limitations shows true scientific thinking,' says Dr. Code. You earn extra mentorship sessions.

skill_explanation.resilience: Facing challenges head-on strengthens your resilience over time.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Thinking about what's fair for everyone involved shows ethical awareness.

choices.label: B. Polish Everything, Hide the Struggles
choices.description: Use ARIA to make your presentation flawless. Don't mention the AI hallucinations or bias issues you found.
choices.feedback: Looks impressive on the surface, but when a panelist asks 'What challenges did you face with AI?' you stumble. They see through the polish. Authenticity matters more than perfection.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Being willing to try something uncertain develops risk tolerance.

choices.label: C. Live Demo of Your AI Workflow
choices.description: Show the panel your actual prompt engineering process live — how you craft prompts, evaluate outputs, and iterate.
choices.feedback: Impressive demonstration! The panel sees your real-time problem-solving skills. When ARIA gives a wrong answer during the demo, you catch it instantly — proving your critical evaluation skills.

skill_explanation.adaptability: Flexibility in your thinking helps you handle change effectively.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Planning your approach carefully is a sign of strategic reasoning.

choices.label: D. Co-Present With Your Study Group
choices.description: Present as a group, showing how you helped each other with AI challenges. Highlight the collaborative learning process.
choices.feedback: Teamwork shines! The panel appreciates that you helped struggling classmates with prompt engineering. Collaboration is a skill that AI can't replace.

skill_explanation.empathy: Taking others' perspectives into account builds empathy.
skill_explanation.adaptability: Adjusting your approach when conditions change shows flexibility.

rounds.situation: Your friend Sameer is panicking — his project is behind schedule. He begs you to share your advanced prompts so he can generate his entire project overnight with ARIA. 'Just this once,' he says. 'Nobody will know.' Meanwhile, another classmate shares that she found a way to bypass the school's AI monitoring tools.
rounds.goal: Navigate a serious ethical dilemma about AI use among friends.
rounds.coaching_moment: Ethical reasoning: Helping friends vs. enabling dishonesty is one of the hardest ethical lines to draw.
rounds.reflection_prompt: Is it wrong to help a friend cheat, even if they're under pressure?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Two students in tense conversation at school cafeteria, one looking stressed holding phone, other looking conflicted, moral dilemma visual cues

choices.label: A. Teach Sameer, Don't Give Answers
choices.description: Spend an hour teaching Sameer how to write good prompts himself. Help him learn, not just copy.
choices.feedback: True friendship! You lost project time but gained something better. Sameer learns to use AI properly and credits you as his 'prompt engineering mentor.' Dr. Code notices your leadership.

skill_explanation.empathy: Understanding the impact on people around you shows care for others.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Choosing what's right over what's easy shows moral courage.

choices.label: B. Share Your Prompts and Methods
choices.description: Give Sameer your prompt templates and let him copy your workflow. He's your friend, after all.
choices.feedback: Sameer's project now looks suspiciously similar to yours. Ms. Verma flags both projects for review. Helping a friend cheat hurts you both — trust is now damaged.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Not always playing it safe helps you grow as a decision-maker.

choices.label: C. Report the Monitoring Bypass
choices.description: Tell Dr. Code about the AI monitoring bypass tool. It's uncomfortable, but other students could be hurt.
choices.feedback: A courageous choice. Some classmates are upset, but Dr. Code thanks you privately. The bypass could have led to mass disqualifications. You protected the integrity of the entire fair.

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Considering fairness in your decision demonstrates ethical thinking.
skill_explanation.resilience: Pushing through difficulty builds mental strength.

choices.label: D. Stay Out of It Entirely
choices.description: Decline to help Sameer and ignore the bypass tool. Focus only on your own project.
choices.feedback: You protected yourself but missed a chance to help. Later, Sameer gets caught and you wonder if you could have prevented it. Inaction is also a choice.

skill_explanation.resilience: Choosing to persist when things get hard develops resilience.

rounds.situation: Disaster! ARIA generated several paragraphs of confident-sounding scientific claims that are completely fabricated. Fake studies, made-up statistics, and invented researcher names are woven throughout your project. Dr. Code just announced that all projects will undergo automated fact-checking next week. You have days to fix this before your credibility is destroyed.
rounds.goal: Contain the hallucination damage and rebuild project integrity.
rounds.coaching_moment: Resilience & critical thinking: AI hallucinations are inevitable. How you recover from them defines your AI literacy.
rounds.reflection_prompt: Why does AI sometimes generate convincing-sounding false information? How can we build safeguards?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student with alarmed expression looking at laptop showing red warning flags on AI-generated text, fact-check marks everywhere, clock showing deadline pressure

choices.label: A. Complete Fact-Check & Rewrite
choices.description: Go through every single claim, verify against real sources, and rewrite fabricated sections with accurate information. Include a 'corrections' appendix.
choices.feedback: Painful but necessary. You lost progress but gained credibility. The 'corrections' appendix actually impresses the judges — you turned a failure into a learning demonstration.

skill_explanation.resilience: Learning from setbacks rather than giving up shows resilience.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Weighing the ethical implications shows principled reasoning.

choices.label: B. Fix Only the Obvious Errors
choices.description: Check the most suspicious-sounding claims and fix those. Hope the automated checker doesn't catch the rest.
choices.feedback: Half-measures fail. The automated checker finds 4 more fabricated sources. Dr. Code is disappointed — you knew there was a problem and didn't fully address it.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Evaluating risk vs. reward is a key life skill.

choices.label: C. Rebuild With Better Prompts
choices.description: Delete all AI-generated content, redesign your prompts with strict citation requirements, and regenerate everything with fact-checking instructions built in.
choices.feedback: Learning from failure! Your new prompts include 'cite only real, verifiable sources' and 'flag any uncertain claims.' This is how prompt engineering improves — through real challenges.

skill_explanation.adaptability: Being open to new information and changing course builds adaptability.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Thinking ahead about consequences shows strategic planning ability.

choices.label: D. Abandon AI for Research Entirely
choices.description: Panic and delete all AI research. Rebuild from scratch using only library books and verified databases.
choices.feedback: An overreaction. The problem wasn't AI itself — it was how you used it. Abandoning the tool means you didn't learn the core lesson about verification.

skill_explanation.resilience: Staying focused under pressure builds your ability to bounce back.

rounds.situation: Ms. Verma has flagged your project for a formal plagiarism review! The school's new AI detection system found high similarity scores between your work and AI-generated content. You have 48 hours to appear before the Academic Integrity Committee and explain your AI usage. Your science fair participation hangs in the balance.
rounds.goal: Defend your work before the Academic Integrity Committee and salvage your project.
rounds.coaching_moment: Ethical reasoning & resilience: Consequences of poor AI ethics are real and immediate. But how you respond matters more than the mistake.
rounds.reflection_prompt: What's the difference between using AI as a tool and passing off AI work as your own?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student sitting before committee of teachers in formal school office, documents spread on table, AI detection report visible, serious atmosphere

choices.label: A. Full Transparency & Accountability
choices.description: Bring your complete prompt history, show exactly what ARIA generated vs. what you wrote, and take responsibility for not attributing properly. Propose a remediation plan.
choices.feedback: Courage and integrity! The committee is impressed by your honesty. You're placed on 'AI probation' — required to document all AI use — but you keep your science fair spot. Ms. Verma says this is the best response she's ever seen.

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Standing by your values even under pressure builds integrity.
skill_explanation.resilience: Facing challenges head-on strengthens your resilience over time.

choices.label: B. Deny AI Misuse
choices.description: Claim you wrote everything yourself and the AI detection system is wrong.
choices.feedback: The committee pulls up your ARIA usage logs from the school network. Denial plus evidence makes everything worse. You're suspended from the science fair and must retake the ethics module.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Taking a calculated risk shows you can handle uncertainty.

choices.label: C. Offer to Resubmit With Proper Attribution
choices.description: Acknowledge the issue, propose rewriting the flagged sections with proper AI attribution labels, and ask for a 1-week extension.
choices.feedback: Reasonable and proactive. The committee grants you 5 days. Your resubmitted work properly credits AI assistance and is stronger for it. A hard lesson learned.

skill_explanation.adaptability: Pivoting your strategy when needed is a sign of adaptive thinking.
skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Thinking about what's fair for everyone involved shows ethical awareness.

choices.label: D. Blame the AI Tool
choices.description: 'ARIA made it look too much like original content. The tool is the problem, not me!'
choices.feedback: Blaming the tool shows a fundamental misunderstanding. 'AI is a tool — YOU are responsible for how you use it,' says Ms. Verma. Your credibility takes a serious hit.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Stepping outside your comfort zone builds risk assessment skills.

rounds.situation: With the crisis behind you, Dr. Code introduces advanced AI techniques: chain-of-thought prompting, role-based prompts, and system instructions. These could dramatically improve your remaining project work — if you master them.
rounds.goal: Level up your prompt engineering skills for the final project push.
rounds.coaching_moment: Strategic thinking: Advanced AI techniques multiply your capabilities, but only if built on a foundation of good practices.
rounds.reflection_prompt: How does learning to communicate better with AI also make you a better communicator with humans?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student writing complex structured prompts on whiteboard, AI interface showing improved outputs, before/after comparison, tech-savvy classroom

choices.label: A. Master Chain-of-Thought Prompting
choices.description: Learn to ask ARIA to 'think step by step' and show its reasoning. This reduces hallucinations and improves accuracy dramatically.
choices.feedback: Game-changer! When ARIA shows its reasoning, you can spot exactly where it goes wrong. Your accuracy improves 40%. This is a skill you'll use for life.

skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Considering long-term impact before acting builds strategic thinking.
skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Investing effort now for later payoff builds discipline.

choices.label: B. Experiment With Role-Based Prompts
choices.description: Assign ARIA different expert roles: 'Act as a botanist,' 'Act as a statistics teacher,' 'Act as a science fair judge reviewing my work.'
choices.feedback: Creative prompt engineering! Having ARIA role-play as a judge helped you find 3 weaknesses in your project. Different perspectives unlock different insights.

skill_explanation.adaptability: Responding to unexpected situations with creativity shows adaptability.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Weighing multiple outcomes before deciding strengthens your planning skills.

choices.label: C. Just Generate More Content Quickly
choices.description: Skip the technique lessons. You're behind schedule — just use basic prompts to crank out project content as fast as possible.
choices.feedback: Speed over skill is a trap. More content doesn't mean better content. Without advanced techniques, you're getting quantity without quality.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Being willing to try something uncertain develops risk tolerance.

choices.label: D. Learn by Teaching Classmates
choices.description: Master one advanced technique and run a lunch-break workshop for classmates. Teaching others deepens your own understanding.
choices.feedback: Teaching is the deepest form of learning! Your workshop helps 8 classmates improve their prompts. Dr. Code gives you bonus credit for peer mentorship.

skill_explanation.empathy: Listening to different viewpoints strengthens your empathy skills.
skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Resisting the quick fix in favor of lasting results shows maturity.

rounds.situation: One week until the science fair! Your project is taking shape, but there's always more to do. ARIA offers to help you create a last-minute 'wow factor' — an interactive AI demo that responds to judges' questions in real-time. It's impressive but risky.
rounds.goal: Make your final strategic decisions before the science fair.
rounds.coaching_moment: Risk assessment: Last-minute additions can impress or backfire. Knowing when to stop adding and start polishing is wisdom.
rounds.reflection_prompt: Is it better to have a polished simple project or an ambitious messy one?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Student putting finishing touches on science fair project board, AI assistant helping with final details, clock showing deadline, determined expression

choices.label: A. Build the Interactive AI Demo
choices.description: Create a live ARIA-powered Q&A system that judges can ask questions to. High-risk, high-reward.
choices.feedback: Bold move! The live demo wows most judges — but ARIA gives one slightly wrong answer. Your ability to correct it in real-time shows genuine mastery.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Not always playing it safe helps you grow as a decision-maker.
skill_explanation.adaptability: Flexibility in your thinking helps you handle change effectively.

choices.label: B. Polish What You Have
choices.description: No new features. Spend the week perfecting your poster, practicing your presentation, and double-checking every fact.
choices.feedback: Discipline over excitement! Your polished, error-free project stands out among rushed last-minute additions. Quality beats quantity every time.

skill_explanation.delayed_gratification: Waiting for the right moment instead of rushing shows self-control.
skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Looking beyond the obvious choice shows you think strategically.

choices.label: C. Add an AI Ethics Reflection Section
choices.description: Write a personal essay about what you learned about AI ethics, bias, and responsible use throughout this project. Make it the heart of your presentation.
choices.feedback: This section becomes the star of your project! Judges say: 'This student doesn't just use AI — they UNDERSTAND it.' Your personal growth narrative is more compelling than any data chart.

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Choosing what's right over what's easy shows moral courage.
skill_explanation.resilience: Pushing through difficulty builds mental strength.

choices.label: D. Cram as Much Content as Possible
choices.description: Use ARIA to generate additional experiments, more data visualizations, and extra pages. More is more!
choices.feedback: Overloaded! Your project is impressive in volume but confusing in focus. A judge comments: 'A lot of AI-generated content but where is the student's own analysis?' Less would have been more.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Evaluating risk vs. reward is a key life skill.

rounds.situation: The big day is here! Your project on plant sound responses is set up. Judges are making rounds. Parents, teachers, and the local newspaper are watching. During your presentation, a judge asks the hardest question: 'Can you explain exactly which parts of this project are yours and which came from AI?'
rounds.goal: Present your project and answer the judge's critical question about AI collaboration.
rounds.coaching_moment: All dimensions converge: This final moment tests everything — your knowledge, ethics, creativity, communication, and resilience.
rounds.reflection_prompt: After 12 weeks with AI, what has this partnership taught you about yourself?
rounds.ai_image_prompt: Science fair scene with student confidently presenting project to judges, colorful project board with AI collaboration clearly labeled, proud moment, school gymnasium

choices.label: A. Give Full Transparent Credit
choices.description: 'ARIA helped me with research compilation, data visualization, and grammar checking. I did the hypothesis, experimental design, analysis interpretation, and conclusions. Here's my documented AI usage log.'
choices.feedback: Standing ovation moment! The judge says: 'THIS is how students should use AI. Full transparency, clear attribution, and genuine learning.' You've set the standard.

skill_explanation.ethical_reasoning: Considering fairness in your decision demonstrates ethical thinking.
skill_explanation.resilience: Choosing to persist when things get hard develops resilience.

choices.label: B. Minimize AI's Role
choices.description: 'Oh, I just used ARIA for some basic spell-checking. Everything else is mine.'
choices.feedback: The judge knows. AI detection tools flagged significant AI-generated content. Your dishonesty in this moment undermines everything. Dr. Code is visibly disappointed.

skill_explanation.risk_tolerance: Taking a calculated risk shows you can handle uncertainty.

choices.label: C. Showcase the Collaboration Process
choices.description: Pull up your 12-week prompt evolution — from vague Week 1 prompts to sophisticated Week 11 chains. Show how you grew alongside AI.
choices.feedback: Brilliant! The judges are fascinated by your learning journey. Showing growth over 12 weeks is more impressive than a perfect final product. The newspaper reporter asks for an interview!

skill_explanation.strategic_thinking: Planning your approach carefully is a sign of strategic reasoning.
skill_explanation.adaptability: Adjusting your approach when conditions change shows flexibility.

choices.label: D. Redirect to the Science
choices.description: 'The AI question is important, but let me tell you about what the plants actually taught us about sound frequencies...' Pivot to your scientific findings.
choices.feedback: Smooth redirect, and your scientific findings ARE strong. But the judge notices you dodged the AI question. In today's world, AI transparency isn't optional — it's expected.

skill_explanation.adaptability: Being open to new information and changing course builds adaptability.
skill_explanation.resilience: Learning from setbacks rather than giving up shows resilience.

glossary_terms.definition: The skill of writing clear, specific instructions for AI systems to get the best possible output.
When an AI confidently generates false information — fake facts, made-up sources, or invented data that sounds convincing.
The tendency to seek or interpret information in ways that confirm what you already believe, which AI can amplify.
Systematic errors in AI output caused by biased training data, leading to unfair or stereotypical results.
An advanced technique where you ask AI to explain its reasoning step by step, improving accuracy and transparency.
The ethical commitment to honest, original work — including properly attributing AI-generated content.
Clearly labeling which parts of your work were created or assisted by AI tools.
The ability to assess AI-generated content for accuracy, bias, and relevance before trusting or using it.

endings.title: AI Ethicist
endings.message: You've become the school's leading voice on responsible AI use! Your project didn't just earn top marks — it changed how your school thinks about AI ethics. Ms. Verma invites you to help write the school's new AI usage policy. Your deep understanding of bias, attribution, and transparency makes you a trusted advisor. You've proven that the most important AI skill isn't prompting — it's integrity.

endings.title: Prompt Engineering Pro
endings.message: Your mastery of prompt engineering is remarkable! From vague first attempts to sophisticated chain-of-thought prompts, you've learned to communicate with AI like a pro. Dr. Code showcases your prompt evolution as an example for next year's students. Tech companies are already looking for people with your skills. You've discovered that talking to AI is itself a valuable language to learn.

endings.title: Creative Collaborator
endings.message: You've cracked the code of human-AI creative partnership! Your project beautifully blends AI capabilities with your unique human perspective. The judges are amazed by how naturally you combine AI-generated insights with your own creative observations. You've shown that the future isn't AI replacing humans OR humans ignoring AI — it's the two working together. Your collaborative skills will serve you for life.

endings.title: Digital Scholar
endings.message: Your project wins the District Science Fair! The judges are impressed not just by your findings, but by the maturity of your AI collaboration. Dr. Code nominates you for the National Science Talent Search. Your secret? You treated AI as a research partner, not a shortcut. Your critical evaluation skills, ethical awareness, and project quality set a new standard. The local newspaper runs a feature: 'Grade 7 Student Shows How AI Should Be Used in Schools.'

endings.title: AI Learner
endings.message: Your journey with AI has been a real learning experience — bumps, mistakes, and all. Your project may not have won top prize, but you understand something most adults don't: AI is powerful, imperfect, and only as good as the person using it. Dr. Code gives you an encouraging nod: 'You've grown more this semester than students who got perfect scores. Keep learning.' The adventure with AI is just beginning.
